name: sentinel-jsonl
producer: OCTA Sentinel kernel sensor (the reference implementation)
description: SHA-256 prefix-chained JSONL journal rooted in the policy digest, with in-chain GAP and COVERAGE records.

bidirectional_test.ref: sensor/openat2-coverage.sh (verify.sh step 16); mutant that declares openat2 without attaching is caught

replay.reference: proofs/govern_concrete.v extracted to OCaml; conformance/ tables agree with include/classify.h over the entire domain

independence.boundary_statement: The journal is written by a userspace daemon fed from a kernel tracepoint ring buffer; the governed session runs as a tagged child with no handle to the journal fd, the ring buffer or the map. A governed process with full control of its own execution context can still: exhaust the ring buffer (declared as GAP), act through a syscall outside the declared surface (declared as COVERAGE), and — if it obtains root and CAP_BPF on the host — detach the probes, which ends the session rather than silently degrading it. It cannot edit a delivered record: the chain is computed outside its address space.

reconciliation.ref: witness/reconcile.py; demo/08-the-witness.sh asserts zero findings on an honest run and the substitution signature on a spoofed one
